TVS Motor Appoints Peyman Kargar as Next Chief Executive Officer

TVS Motor Company has appointed Peyman Kargar, a global business head with automotive experience, as its next Chief Executive Officer. Kargar, who is French, will be based in TVS' Bengaluru office. He is set to take over the role after January 2027, succeeding the current leadership. The company has not specified the exact date of the transition.
